label: Spark Burst
author: Conky-Studio
description: Radial sparks / star-burst lines. Intensity and count scale with Trigger — celebration or alert chrome.
lua_draw_body:
local cx, cy = {cx}, {cy}
 local n = math.floor({rays} + 0.5)
 local energy = math.min(tonumber({trigger}) or 0, 100) / 100
 local rot = math.rad(wall_clock() * {spin})
 local r, g, b = {color}
 cairo_set_line_cap(cr, CAIRO_LINE_CAP_ROUND)
 cairo_set_line_width(cr, {line_width})
 for i = 0, n - 1 do
  local a = rot + i * (2 * math.pi / n)
  local len = {inner} + ({outer} - {inner}) * (0.4 + 0.6 * energy)
  -- alternate short/long
  if i % 2 == 1 then len = len * 0.65 end
  local flicker = 0.7 + 0.3 * math.sin(wall_clock() * 8 + i)
  cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, r, g, b, {opacity} * energy * flicker)
  cairo_move_to(cr, cx + math.cos(a) * {inner}, cy + math.sin(a) * {inner})
  cairo_line_to(cr, cx + math.cos(a) * len, cy + math.sin(a) * len)
  cairo_stroke(cr)
 end
